explanation: Setting `self.DESCRIPTION` as an instance attribute mutates what may be a class-level variable, meaning if `DESCRIPTION` is falsy on the class, the first instantiation will set it on the instance but subsequent instantiations could still see the class-level falsy value rather than the previously set instance value, and more critically, assigning to `self.DESCRIPTION` when it is a class attribute could shadow or unexpectedly modify shared state across instances depending on the class definition.
